items.name: glitch-text
items.title: Glitch Text
items.description: RGB-split slices that stutter across the text, like a corrupted signal.

items.name: motion-blur-text
items.title: Motion Blur Text
items.description: Text that snaps into place dragging a blurred trail behind it.

items.name: speed-lines
items.title: Speed Lines
items.description: Slanted bars streaking across a container. Drop it behind a hero or a card.

items.name: scanlines
items.title: Scanlines
items.description: CRT scanlines with a soft rolling band and optional flicker. Pure CSS overlay.

items.name: chromatic-hover
items.title: Chromatic Hover
items.description: Chromatic aberration that jitters on hover. Works on images, text, anything.

items.name: pixel-reveal
items.title: Pixel Reveal
items.description: Content appears as a grid of blocks dissolves in a pseudo-random order.

items.name: decode-text
items.title: Decode Text
items.description: Text that scrambles through random glyphs and settles left to right, like a decrypting terminal.

items.name: neon-text
items.title: Neon Text
items.description: Neon sign glow built from layered shadows, with an occasional tube flicker.

items.name: wave-text
items.title: Wave Text
items.description: Letters bob up and down in a rolling wave, each one a beat behind the last.

items.name: magnetic
items.title: Magnetic
items.description: Pulls its child toward the cursor while you hover close, then springs back with a little overshoot.

items.name: tilt-card
items.title: Tilt Card
items.description: 3D tilt that follows the cursor, with a glare highlight that tracks the pointer.

items.name: shutter-reveal
items.title: Shutter Reveal
items.description: Content is uncovered by slanted bars that slide away one after another.

items.name: grid-floor
items.title: Grid Floor
items.description: Synthwave perspective grid scrolling toward the viewer, with a glowing horizon fade. Pure CSS.

items.name: film-grain
items.title: Film Grain
items.description: Animated film grain overlay built from SVG turbulence, cycling through four pre-rendered frames.

items.name: vhs-overlay
items.title: VHS Overlay
items.description: Worn tape look: drifting tracking bands, cyan and magenta color bleed, and a tiny vertical jitter.

items.name: dot-grid
items.title: Dot Grid
items.description: A dot-grid background with a soft spotlight that follows the cursor and lights up the dots near it.

items.name: glow-border
items.title: Glow Border
items.description: A card whose border lights up around the cursor, like modern SaaS cards.

items.name: ripple-click
items.title: Ripple Click
items.description: A material-style ripple that spreads from the exact point you click.

items.name: fade-in-view
items.title: Fade In View
items.description: Fades and slides its children in when they scroll into view. Directional, with delay and replay.

items.name: marquee
items.title: Marquee
items.description: Infinite horizontal scroller for logos, text or cards. Seamless loop with soft edge fade.

items.name: aurora
items.title: Aurora
items.description: Soft aurora background of blurred gradient blobs drifting slowly. Pure CSS.

items.name: typewriter
items.title: Typewriter
items.description: Types one or more strings with a blinking cursor, deleting and moving on to the next. Width stays stable.

items.name: gradient-text
items.title: Gradient Text
items.description: Text filled with a gradient that sweeps across it in a seamless loop.

items.name: count-up
items.title: Count Up
items.description: A number that counts up with easing when it scrolls into view, formatted for any locale.

items.name: dock
items.title: Dock
items.description: A macOS-style dock whose icons swell smoothly as the cursor passes over them, with a label tooltip on each.

items.name: pill-nav
items.title: Pill Nav
items.description: A horizontal nav with a single pill that glides to the hovered or selected item.

items.name: accordion
items.title: Accordion
items.description: Expandable sections whose panels animate their height with a rotating chevron. Single or multiple open.

items.name: carousel
items.title: Carousel
items.description: Scroll-snap slider with arrow buttons, dot indicators, keyboard control and optional autoplay.

items.name: stepper
items.title: Stepper
items.description: Multi-step flow with numbered progress, a line that fills as you advance, and sliding step content.

items.name: image-compare
items.title: Image Compare
items.description: Before and after slider. Drag the handle or use the arrow keys to reveal either side.

items.name: masonry
items.title: Masonry
items.description: Responsive column layout for mixed-height blocks, with a staggered entrance.

items.name: animated-list
items.title: Animated List
items.description: Keyboard-friendly list with a staggered entrance, a sliding highlight and scroll fades.

items.name: bento-grid
items.title: Bento Grid
items.description: Bento layout of spanning cards with a cursor spotlight and a hover lift.

items.name: hold-button
items.title: Hold Button
items.description: Press and hold to confirm. A fill sweeps across while held, letting go early snaps it back.

items.name: spring-toggle
items.title: Spring Toggle
items.description: A switch whose knob squishes and overshoots when you flip it.

items.name: segmented-control
items.title: Segmented Control
items.description: iOS-style segmented control with a thumb that slides to the selected option.

items.name: tooltip
items.title: Tooltip
items.description: A tooltip that trails the pointer with a soft lag, and settles in a fixed spot for keyboard focus.

items.name: scrub-field
items.title: Scrub Field
items.description: A numeric input you drag sideways to change, like the fields in design tools. Typing and arrow keys still work.

items.name: flip-card
items.title: Flip Card
items.description: A card that flips in 3D to reveal its back on hover, focus or click. Crossfades with reduced motion.

items.name: toast-stack
items.title: Toast Stack
items.description: Stacked notifications that slide in, pause on hover and dismiss by button, swipe or timeout.

items.name: lattice-loader
items.title: Lattice Loader
items.description: A compact loading indicator of dots or bars pulsing in a diagonal wave.

items.name: star-rating
items.title: Star Rating
items.description: Interactive star rating with hover preview, half steps and keyboard control.

items.name: features-section
items.title: Features Section
items.description: A heading and a grid of feature cards with icon, title and description. Cards lift on hover and carry a soft cursor spotlight.

items.name: testimonials-section
items.title: Testimonials Section
items.description: A heading and quote cards in a looping horizontal strip that pauses on hover. Falls back to a static grid.

items.name: faq-section
items.title: FAQ Section
items.description: Two-column FAQ: heading and contact link on the left, an animated one-at-a-time accordion on the right.

items.name: cta-banner
items.title: CTA Banner
items.description: A full-width call-to-action band with a soft pulsing radial glow, a headline, one line of text and two pill buttons.

items.name: plasma
items.title: Plasma
items.description: Classic plasma: a small buffer of interfering sine waves mapped through a color gradient and upscaled smooth. Canvas, no dependencies.

items.name: particles
items.title: Particles
items.description: Drifting dots joined by faint lines when they are close, gently pushed away by the pointer. Constellation style.

items.name: light-rays
items.title: Light Rays
items.description: Volumetric light rays fanning out from a point near the top, slowly swaying and pulsing with a radial falloff and additive blending.

items.name: beams
items.title: Beams
items.description: Diagonal light beams sweeping slowly across a dark background, with soft edges and a gentle shimmer. Canvas 2D, additive blending.

items.name: hyperspeed
items.title: Hyperspeed
items.description: A starfield tunnel: stars streak out from a vanishing point with blurred trails, and accelerate on press or boost.

items.name: silk
items.title: Silk
items.description: Layered sine waves filled with soft gradients that drift and breathe, like folded fabric.

items.name: hero-section
items.title: Hero Section
items.description: A full landing hero: eyebrow pill, headline with a highlighted word, subtitle, two pill buttons, trust items and a framed panel for a screenshot or demo.

items.name: pricing-section
items.title: Pricing Section
items.description: Three pricing tiers with a sliding monthly/yearly toggle, crossfading prices, feature checklists and a highlighted most-popular plan.

items.name: login-card
items.title: Login Card
items.description: A centered sign-in card with social buttons, floating-label fields, error alert, loading state and sign-up link.

items.name: split-text
items.title: Split Text
items.description: Characters or words fade, slide up and sharpen in one after another with a stagger.

items.name: blur-text
items.title: Blur Text
items.description: Words come into focus from a heavy blur with a soft upward drift, staggered.

items.name: rotating-text
items.title: Rotating Text
items.description: Cycles through a list of words, each sliding up and out while the next flips in from below, letter by letter.

items.name: scroll-velocity-text
items.title: Scroll Velocity Text
items.description: A repeating text strip that drifts on its own and speeds up, slows down or reverses with the page scroll velocity.

items.name: stroke-text
items.title: Stroke Text
items.description: Hollow outlined text that fills with color in a left to right sweep on hover.

items.name: split-flap-text
items.title: Split-Flap Text
items.description: Airport departure board: every character flips through a set of glyphs until it lands on the target. Changing the text re-runs it.

items.name: blob-cursor
items.title: Blob Cursor
items.description: A soft gooey blob that trails the cursor with lag, merging three circles through an SVG goo filter.

items.name: click-spark
items.title: Click Spark
items.description: A burst of short lines radiates from every click and fades, like a cartoon impact.

items.name: cursor-trail
items.title: Cursor Trail
items.description: A fading trail of dots or a tapered ribbon that follows the cursor on a canvas.

items.name: shimmer-button
items.title: Shimmer Button
items.description: A dark pill with a soft highlight sweeping across its surface and an inner glow that blooms on hover.

items.name: border-beam-button
items.title: Border Beam Button
items.description: A thin beam of light travels around the border of a dark button and brightens on hover.

items.name: liquid-button
items.title: Liquid Button
items.description: On hover a liquid rises from the bottom with a rippling wavy edge while the label color inverts.

items.name: icon-morph-button
items.title: Icon Morph Button
items.description: A label with an icon chip. On hover the icon slides out while a second icon slides in and crossfades.

items.name: confetti-button
items.title: Confetti Button
items.description: Click and a burst of small rectangles and circles pops out and falls with gravity while the label swaps to a success message.

items.name: pay-button
items.title: Pay Button
items.description: A payment button that moves from idle to processing to success, with a spinner, a drawn check and a pop.

items.name: flip-countdown
items.title: Flip Countdown
items.description: A split-flap countdown clock. Each digit folds down in 3D with a soft shadow, grouped into days, hours, minutes and seconds.

items.name: page-transition
items.title: Page Transition
items.description: Wrap your page content and animate it in whenever the route changes. Fade, slide, blur or a curtain wipe.

items.name: slide-show
items.title: Slide Show
items.description: A full-bleed slideshow with a slow Ken Burns zoom, animated captions, arrows, dots, an autoplay progress bar, swipe and keyboard control.

items.name: curtain-reveal
items.title: Curtain Reveal
items.description: Two curtain panels slide apart to uncover your content, with an optional label that fades out first.

items.name: morph-tabs
items.title: Morph Tabs
items.description: Tabs where the container smoothly resizes to each panel, panels crossfade with a slight scale, and a pill glides between triggers.

items.name: sparkline
items.title: Sparkline
items.description: A tiny smooth line with an optional area fill and a glowing end dot that draws in on mount.

items.name: stat-card
items.title: Stat Card
items.description: KPI card with a counting value, a green or red delta pill, a caption and an embedded sparkline.

items.name: bar-chart
items.title: Bar Chart
items.description: Vertical bars with rounded tops, grid lines, optional stacked series, grow-in motion and a hover tooltip.

items.name: area-chart
items.title: Area Chart
items.description: Smooth monotone line over a gradient area with a hover crosshair, dot and tooltip, and a draw-in animation.

items.name: donut-chart
items.title: Donut Chart
items.description: Gapped arc segments that sweep in, a centered total, a percentage legend and hover that expands a segment.

items.name: data-table
items.title: Data Table
items.description: Sortable table with sticky header, zebra rows, status pills, an empty state and optional pagination.

items.name: command-palette
items.title: Command Palette
items.description: A Cmd+K modal with fuzzy search, grouped results, arrow-key navigation and a focus trap.

items.name: sidebar-nav
items.title: Sidebar Nav
items.description: A collapsible app sidebar with a sliding active indicator, badges and icon-only tooltips.

items.name: activity-feed
items.title: Activity Feed
items.description: A vertical timeline of events with avatars, detail cards and a staggered entrance.

items.name: notification-bell
items.title: Notification Bell
items.description: A bell button with a popping badge, a ring on new items and an unread dropdown.

items.name: tabs-underline
items.title: Tabs Underline
items.description: Tabs with a measured sliding underline, icons, counts and crossfading panels.

items.name: kanban-board
items.title: Kanban Board
items.description: Columns of cards you can drag between lists and reorder, with a placeholder slot and add buttons.

items.name: streaming-text
items.title: Streaming Text
items.description: Reveals an assistant reply word by word with a blinking cursor. Supports bold, inline code and line breaks. The server render shows the full text.

items.name: chat-thread
items.title: Chat Thread
items.description: A scrolling conversation with user and assistant bubbles, avatars, timestamps, a streaming last reply, a typing indicator and auto-scroll to the newest message.

items.name: tool-call-card
items.title: Tool Call Card
items.description: A collapsible card for a tool invocation with status, duration, syntax-colored arguments and result, and a copy button.

items.name: thinking-indicator
items.title: Thinking Indicator
items.description: A compact thinking state that cycles through phrases with a fade, as a shimmering label or breathing dots, with an optional elapsed timer.

items.name: prompt-bar
items.title: Prompt Bar
items.description: A chat composer with an auto-growing textarea, attach and mic buttons, a model picker and a send button. Enter sends, Shift+Enter adds a line.

items.name: agent-steps
items.title: Agent Steps
items.description: A vertical plan or trace with pending, active, done and failed steps joined by a connector line that fills as steps complete.

items.name: like-burst
items.title: Like Burst
items.description: A heart button that fills with a bouncy pop, scatters a ring of particles and rolls its count to the new value.

items.name: review-card
items.title: Review Card
items.description: A customer review with avatar, half-star rating, a Read more clamp, a verified badge and a helpful vote.

items.name: avatar-stack
items.title: Avatar Stack
items.description: Overlapping avatars with a +N tail. Hovering spreads them apart and shows a name tooltip.

items.name: share-row
items.title: Share Row
items.description: A row of share pills with monochrome glyphs that pick up each platform's accent on hover, a copy-link pill and a native share button.

items.name: rating-summary
items.title: Rating Summary
items.description: The average rating as a big number with stars and review total, beside five bars that fill in on mount.

items.name: navbar-glass
items.title: Navbar Glass
items.description: A frosted glass navbar with a sliding hover pill, a keyboard-navigable mega menu and a hamburger layout that takes over in narrow containers.

items.name: footer-columns
items.title: Footer Columns
items.description: A full website footer with a brand blurb, social buttons, link columns, a newsletter mini-form, legal links and a live status pill.

items.name: announcement-bar
items.title: Announcement Bar
items.description: A slim banner that rotates through messages with a vertical slide, pauses on hover and can be dismissed.

items.name: cookie-banner
items.title: Cookie Banner
items.description: A consent card with Accept all, Reject non-essential and a Customize panel of category switches. It slides up on mount.

items.name: newsletter-signup
items.title: Newsletter Signup
items.description: An email capture block with inline validation and shake, a spinner while submitting and a success state that morphs the button into a check.

items.name: breadcrumbs
items.title: Breadcrumbs
items.description: A breadcrumb trail that truncates long labels and folds the middle of deep paths into an ellipsis menu.

items.name: pagination
items.title: Pagination
items.description: Page navigation with ellipsis collapsing, an indicator that slides between pages and a compact variant with a page select.

items.name: dialog-modal
items.title: Dialog Modal
items.description: An accessible modal with a blurred scrim, scale-and-fade transitions, a focus trap and focus returned to the trigger.

items.name: dropdown-menu
items.title: Dropdown Menu
items.description: A button-triggered menu driven by a data array, with icons, shortcuts, checkbox items, a side submenu and the full keyboard model.

items.name: dropzone
items.title: Dropzone
items.description: A file upload area with an animated dashed drag-over border, type and size checks, inline errors and a file list with simulated progress. It never uploads anything.

items.name: empty-state
items.title: Empty State
items.description: A zero-data state with four floating inline illustrations, a title, a description and primary and secondary actions.

items.name: skeleton
items.title: Skeleton
items.description: Shimmering loading placeholders: a rect, circle and text primitive. SkeletonCard, SkeletonList and SkeletonProfile ship in the same file.

items.name: radar-chart
items.title: Radar Chart
items.description: A multi-axis radar chart with up to three translucent series, grid rings, point tooltips and a legend that hides or shows each series.

items.name: heatmap-calendar
items.title: Heatmap Calendar
items.description: A GitHub-style activity grid with month and weekday labels, an intensity legend and a hover tooltip with date and count. Ships a deterministic sampleActivity helper.

items.name: funnel-chart
items.title: Funnel Chart
items.description: A conversion funnel of centered trapezoid stages with absolute values, share of the first stage and the drop-off between stages.

items.name: gauge-meter
items.title: Gauge Meter
items.description: A semicircular gauge with colored zones, tick marks, an animated needle and a large readout that counts to the value.

items.name: multi-line-chart
items.title: Multi-line Chart
items.description: Smooth lines on shared axes with an interactive legend, a crosshair that snaps to the nearest point and a tooltip listing every series.

items.name: progress-rings
items.title: Progress Rings
items.description: Concentric activity rings with rounded gradient strokes, an animated sweep, a center slot and a legend with value and goal.

items.name: ranked-bars
items.title: Ranked Bars
items.description: Horizontal ranking bars with rank, label, value and share of total, plus optional delta badges and an animated show more toggle.

items.name: candlestick-chart
items.title: Candlestick Chart
items.description: OHLC candlesticks with wicks, a price axis, a volume strip, a crosshair with a price tag and an OHLC tooltip. Ships a deterministic sampleCandles helper.

items.name: people-list
items.title: People List
items.description: A team directory with initials avatars, presence dots, role badges, a keyboard-friendly row menu and a search field with an animated empty state.

items.name: file-list
items.title: File List
items.description: Files and folders with a list and grid view, type-colored icons, multi-select checkboxes and a selection toolbar that slides in.

items.name: leaderboard
items.title: Leaderboard
items.description: A ranked list with medals for the top three, proportional score bars that grow in, rank change arrows and a pinned row for the current user.

items.name: transaction-list
items.title: Transaction List
items.description: Transactions grouped under sticky day headings, with merchant tiles, status chips, tabular amounts and an expandable detail row with a copy button.

items.name: inbox-list
items.title: Inbox List
items.description: Email-style rows with unread dots, star toggles, checkboxes, hover quick actions that replace the time and j/k keyboard navigation.

items.name: product-grid
items.title: Product Grid
items.description: A shop listing with an animated category chip row, sort select, result count and a container-responsive grid that reflows with a FLIP animation.

items.name: sortable-list
items.title: Sortable List
items.description: A drag-to-reorder list with pointer dragging, siblings that slide out of the way, and full keyboard reordering with live announcements.

items.name: sidebar-floating
items.title: Sidebar Floating
items.description: A frosted, rounded sidebar inset from the page edge with labeled groups, an active pill that glides between items and a user card with a live status dot.

items.name: sidebar-rail
items.title: Sidebar Rail
items.description: A 56px icon rail. Hovering or focusing an item opens a flyout with its submenu, and items without a submenu show a tooltip. Arrow keys move through the rail.

items.name: sidebar-docs
items.title: Sidebar Docs
items.description: Documentation navigation with a search field, collapsible groups that animate their height, nested links on a connected guide line and a marker that follows the active page.

items.name: sidebar-workspace
items.title: Sidebar Workspace
items.description: A workspace app sidebar with a keyboard-friendly workspace switcher, sections with counts, collapsible favorites, a usage card with an upgrade button and a user menu.

items.name: sidebar-drawer
items.title: Sidebar Drawer
items.description: A slide-in navigation drawer with a scrim. It fills its nearest positioned parent, traps Tab focus, closes on Escape or a scrim click and returns focus to the trigger.

items.name: sidebar-tree
items.title: Sidebar Tree
items.description: A file explorer tree with animated folders, colored file type icons, a filter field and the full tree keyboard model.

items.name: shiny-text
items.title: Shiny Text
items.description: Text with a band of light that glides across the glyphs on a loop, like a reflection passing over brushed metal.

items.name: spotlight-card
items.title: Spotlight Card
items.description: A card lit by a soft radial spotlight that follows the pointer and catches the border. Wrap several in SpotlightGroup and one light spans the whole row.

items.name: meteors
items.title: Meteors
items.description: A shower of shooting stars with fading tails over a faint, twinkling star field. Pure CSS, fills its positioned parent.

items.name: mesh-gradient
items.title: Mesh Gradient
items.description: A living mesh gradient: large blurred color fields drift on independent looping paths and blend where they meet, with optional film grain.

items.name: orbit-icons
items.title: Orbit Icons
items.description: A central hub with concentric rings of icon tiles that orbit at different speeds and stay upright. Hovering pauses the motion.

items.name: animated-beam
items.title: Animated Beam
items.description: An integrations diagram: sources on the left feed a central hub that sends to an output, with a light pulse running along each curved connection. Beams re-route on resize.

items.name: glass-card
items.title: Glass Card
items.description: A frosted glass card with a fine noise texture, a bright inner rim and a specular highlight that tracks the pointer as the card tilts slightly. Best over color.

items.name: ripple-grid
items.title: Ripple Grid
items.description: A field of small tiles where a click or hover sends a radial wave that lifts, scales and lights them by distance. Ripples from the center on its own when idle.

items.name: analytics-dashboard
items.title: Analytics Dashboard
items.description: A full website analytics screen: KPI cards with sparklines, an area chart with a 7D, 30D and 90D toggle, top pages, a traffic sources donut and a live online counter.

items.name: sales-dashboard
items.title: Sales Dashboard
items.description: A revenue overview with revenue and order KPIs, a goal progress ring, a revenue versus target combo chart, regional sales, a conversion funnel and a sortable top products table.

items.name: project-dashboard
items.title: Project Dashboard
items.description: A sprint overview with a progress header, task status tiles, a burndown chart, team workload bars, a mini kanban summary and checkable upcoming deadlines.

items.name: finance-dashboard
items.title: Finance Dashboard
items.description: A banking overview with a total balance card, a gradient debit card, income versus expenses bars, a spending donut, recent transactions and savings goals you can top up.

items.name: admin-dashboard
items.title: Admin Dashboard
items.description: A users admin page with search, role and status filters, a sortable table, row selection with a bulk action bar, pagination and a slide-in detail panel.

items.name: orders-dashboard
items.title: Orders Dashboard
items.description: An e-commerce orders screen with stat tiles, status tabs that filter an orders table, payment and fulfillment chips and a timeline panel for the selected order.
